claude.description: Documented. Primary brand accent, used for the spinner and assistant label.

claudeShimmer.description: Documented. Lighter color paired with `claude` in the spinner's animated gradient.

claudeBlue_FOR_SYSTEM_SPINNER.description: Internal. Blue variant of the brand accent used by the system spinner; pairs with `claudeBlueShimmer_FOR_SYSTEM_SPINNER`.

inverseText.description: Documented. Text drawn on top of a colored background, such as status badges.

inactive.description: Documented. Secondary text such as hints, timestamps, and disabled items.

inactiveShimmer.description: Internal. Shimmer variant of `inactive` for animated gradients.

subtle.description: Documented. Faint borders and de-emphasized secondary text.

permission.description: Documented. Dialog borders, including permission prompts and pickers.

permissionShimmer.description: Internal. Shimmer variant of `permission` for animated gradients.

suggestion.description: Internal. Suggestion-tier UI accents (autocomplete prompts, hint banners).

background.description: Internal. General background fill for surfaces that opt into a color (rare).

success.description: Documented. Success messages and passing checks.

warning.description: Documented. Warnings, caution messages, and the auto mode border.

warningShimmer.description: Documented. Lighter color paired with `warning` in animated gradients.

promptBorder.description: Documented. Input box border in the default permission mode.

promptBorderShimmer.description: Internal. Shimmer variant of `promptBorder` for animated gradients.

planMode.description: Documented. Plan mode accent and border.

autoAccept.description: Documented. Accept-edits mode accent and border.

bashBorder.description: Documented. Input box border when entering a `!` shell command.

fastModeShimmer.description: Internal. Shimmer variant of `fastMode` for animated gradients.

diffAddedDimmed.description: Documented. Background of unchanged context near added lines.

diffRemovedDimmed.description: Documented. Background of unchanged context near removed lines.

diffAddedWord.description: Documented. Word-level highlight within an added line.

diffRemovedWord.description: Documented. Word-level highlight within a removed line.

userMessageBackground.description: Documented (fullscreen mode only). Background behind your messages in the transcript.

messageActionsBackground.description: Internal. Background fill behind per-message action affordances.

selectionBg.description: Documented (fullscreen mode only). Background of text selected with the mouse.

bashMessageBackgroundColor.description: Internal. Background fill for shell-command (`!`) messages in fullscreen mode.

memoryBackgroundColor.description: Internal. Background fill for memory / `CLAUDE.md` annotations in fullscreen mode.

rate_limit_fill.description: Internal. Filled portion of the rate-limit usage bar.

rate_limit_empty.description: Internal. Empty portion of the rate-limit usage bar.

briefLabelYou.description: Internal. "You" label color in brief / compact transcript mode.

briefLabelClaude.description: Internal. "Claude" label color in brief / compact transcript mode.

professionalBlue.description: Internal. Anthropic-blue brand accent used in marketing surfaces (login screens, billing UI).

chromeYellow.description: Internal. Yellow accent used in marketing surfaces.

clawd_body.description: Internal. Body color for the Clawd mascot easter-egg art.

clawd_background.description: Internal. Background color behind the Clawd mascot easter-egg art.

rainbow_red.description: Internal. Red stop in the rainbow palette (animated celebration sequences).

rainbow_orange.description: Internal. Orange stop in the rainbow palette.

rainbow_yellow.description: Internal. Yellow stop in the rainbow palette.

rainbow_green.description: Internal. Green stop in the rainbow palette.

rainbow_blue.description: Internal. Blue stop in the rainbow palette.

rainbow_indigo.description: Internal. Indigo stop in the rainbow palette.

rainbow_violet.description: Internal. Violet stop in the rainbow palette.

blue_FOR_SUBAGENTS_ONLY.description: Documented. Color drawn for subagents declared with `color: blue`.

green_FOR_SUBAGENTS_ONLY.description: Documented. Color drawn for subagents declared with `color: green`.

yellow_FOR_SUBAGENTS_ONLY.description: Documented. Color drawn for subagents declared with `color: yellow`.
